# #1073 OmniRoute dispositions — 2026-10-16 through 2026-10-23 UTC

Owner-requested recorded dispositions, not a selection slate. Static metadata and source comparison only; no product code changed.

## Population and metadata

The inclusive UTC merge window is `2026-10-16T00:00:00Z` through `2026-10-23T23:59:59Z`. The bounded GitHub merged-PR search returned **597** records; the saved source index `/tmp/omni-oct-2026-10-07-31.json` independently contains the same **597 unique PR numbers** for those timestamps. Set comparison found **0 missing and 0 extra** numbers. The search result is below the 1,000-result ceiling.

For all 597 records, GraphQL final-head, merge OID and merge timestamp matched the pinned source-index metadata. Changed-file metadata returned **24,738 paths**. All 597 `totalCount` values reconcile to retrieved paths. Thirty-six PRs exceeded the first 100-file GraphQL page; all were completed through REST file pagination, with no pagination errors and no remaining path gaps. No row relies on title or a diff-stat as changed-file evidence.

Rows labeled unresolved are intentionally unresolved, not rejected. Docs/test/CI-only and Provider Sign-in lane rows are assigned from their complete path sets and titles. Five existing-provider/protocol cases received focused static comparison below. No unverified runtime row is described as already present or ported. Prior report/landed-PR credit is cited only when directly established; none of these 597 sources had an exact source-PR citation in the existing `internal/docs/port-reports/` files.

## Focused existing-provider/protocol comparisons

- [OmniRoute #17119](https://github.com/cheaper-inference/OmniRoute/pull/17119) — Final source head `edfa47384e8f8171bba48e448ba57d62a71fd29b`; merge `20683172beed44ccf29e86863c3217e5c6eb0808`. Diff introduces a client-declaration-aware name restorer and threads `body.tools` through streaming and non-streaming response translation, preserving explicit empty declarations and legacy fallback. Local `restoreClaudeToolNames` only restores aliases; the client’s declared spelling is not used as a fallback before Claude Code canonicalization. This is a confirmed narrow existing Messages-path gap. Offline acceptance is specified in the row; no code changed.
- [OmniRoute #17310](https://github.com/cheaper-inference/OmniRoute/pull/17310) — Final source head `12fa6a55bf0b28e1cd63687a2ebe4a8457606807`; merge `141844081819e333a4b251e0a9b62acc014f2b7c`. The source adds metadata to identify synthesized Responses tool-output messages, keeps the newest output in the active turn, and restores engine-injected messages absent from `input[]`. Local `bodyAdapter.js` adapts `function_call_output`; the local Responses-format test checks shape/order/pairing but not this current-turn/injected-message contract. Because local compression engines and source metadata differ, applicability is unresolved; the row records narrow future acceptance without implementing a duplicate adapter.
- [OmniRoute #17239](https://github.com/cheaper-inference/OmniRoute/pull/17239) — Final source head `b6e252b5a36bd89c9dfea2086d75e1ca1ee0260a`; merge `847931fba1002a8fbd63619a5053a83083b94f49`. The diff lets buffered parsing read native top-level Gemini candidates in addition to wrapped `{response}` data and adds offline text/tool/usage fixtures. Local `stream.js` recognizes both candidate envelopes in streaming paths, but no matching local buffered-response contract test was located. This comparison does not establish parity or a confirmed gap.
- [OmniRoute #17258](https://github.com/cheaper-inference/OmniRoute/pull/17258) — Final source head `b3ba2a220e75baeca9fbd10cfdb3e814cca618cb`; merge `6e12c409f7278004475eee697450f5c57b76bba9`. The diff extends upstream Headroom compression text extraction/reconstruction into string and nested-block Anthropic `tool_result` content. Local Headroom is a proxy adapter and its preservation test confirms tool history is not forwarded to that external proxy. That is a different safety contract; no local equivalent engine path or applicable gap was established.
- [OmniRoute #17210](https://github.com/cheaper-inference/OmniRoute/pull/17210) — Final source head `dc9f2c24ea77d7f3f051699f4537dbc4dfedd961`; merge `e8ba277f9d251fb2281658ead86662862c016d2c`. The source changes Codex request filtering to pass caller `reasoning.context` while continuing to strip OpenRouter-only keys, with legacy/catalog-backed fixtures. Local Codex HTTP filtering retains `effort` and `summary` only, and `tests/unit/codex-client-version-and-reasoning.test.js` locks that whitelist. This confirms the field-preservation gap for that existing route, while backend/model support remains source-dependent; row acceptance stays scoped to the HTTP/Responses request path.
